assumptions.statement_zh: 组织方尚未发布官方总体边界与重点区域 polygon，本方案全部几何为 provisional 临时粗略约束，仅用于内容设计与机器校验；官方图形发布后必须整体复算。
assumptions.statement_en: No official boundary or key-area polygons are published yet; all geometry here is provisional and must be recomputed when official data arrives.

assumptions.statement_zh: 轨道保护区与遗址公园绿带管控条件、地方性AI治理规则均未知，本方案不给出任何具体数值结论，仅保留概念口径的示意。
assumptions.statement_en: Statutory control conditions and local AI-governance rules are unknown; this proposal keeps concept-level indications only.

assumptions.statement_zh: 治理试验数据仅作概念性匿名聚合引用，不替代官方统计，不涉及任何真实个体信息。
assumptions.statement_en: Governance-experiment data are concept-level anonymized references only, not official statistics.

assumptions.statement_zh: 治理实验室、算法审计塔与标识步道设施均为原创概念建议，模块化可逆，不构成建设承诺。
assumptions.statement_en: All node facilities are original reversible conceptual proposals, not construction commitments.

assumptions.statement_zh: 公众参与沙盒与城市AI观测仅提供匿名聚合与人工复核兜底，不设个体识别采集，不设无法人工终止的自动决定。
assumptions.statement_en: Sandbox and urban-observation sensing processes anonymized aggregates only, with human review as backstop.

assumptions.statement_zh: AI治理开放日、算法审计公开周与合成内容标识艺术展等均为建议性设计，不代表已确定的政府安排或投资承诺。
assumptions.statement_en: The event system and phasing are design suggestions, not confirmed government or investment commitments.

assumptions.statement_zh: 与北纬社区、未来科学城、怀柔科学城、经开区及京津冀的协同均为概念方向研判，不构成任何机构间承诺或已定安排。
assumptions.statement_en: Coordination with Beiwei Community, Future Science City, Huairou Science City, the Econ-Tech Development Area and the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region is concept-level directional research only, not any inter-institutional commitment.

assumptions.statement_zh: 试点与活动成本等级（低/中/高）为定性概念分级，不构成投资承诺；估算方法与价格基期见成本口径说明，官方立项预算批复后复算。
assumptions.statement_en: Pilot and event cost tiers (low/medium/high) are qualitative concept levels, not investment commitments; estimation method and price base are stated; recompute after official project/budget approval.

assumptions.statement_zh: 「数轨京张/JINGRAIL」「智治绿廊/Zhi-Reg Green Loop」及节点名称为原创概念命名，概念阶段未完成商标检索，按内部工作代号处理，限制对外使用与注册。
assumptions.statement_en: The names JINGRAIL, Zhi-Reg Green Loop and the node names are original concept names; no trademark search has been completed at the concept stage; they are treated as internal working codenames, restricted from external use and registration.
